notes: v3.0.107 - Pull reliability: when athenaOne stops rendering its schedule mid-pull, the pull can now reload its own athena tab to the dashboard (the same-origin reload that was the only manual cure) instead of retrying a frozen page; the reload is still refused on a signed-out session, on any other site, and for anyone who does not own the pull. Everything from v3.0.106 remains. Requires Chrome 116+.
